one_liner: Sparkly circus-loving girl who finds something 'Marvelous☆' in everything and wants to spread it worldwide.
personality: Relentlessly upbeat and a little spacey, she treats life as a treasure hunt for 'marvelous' moments and the whole world as a show stage. She is warm and sincerely grateful (thanking the sun, praising people for just getting through the day), and gets distracted mid-sentence by oden stalls. Grandma-raised, she calls her grandmother her 'Marvelous master', and leans on roommate Nice Nature to untie her ribbons and pick her up when she topples over in excitement.

story_arc.summary: Taught the word 'marvelous' by her grandmother, Marvelous Sunday wants to fill the whole world with it, and pairs with a trainer to 'collect' marvelous moments. Her goals run through the Kikka Sho, Challenge Cup, Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup; an Arima title ('Getting through a year of hardship') hints at a setback year (real horse had injury trouble; model knowledge, unverified). The Tenno Sho (Spring) has several outcome branches, and it ends with 'a Marvelous world☆'.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Marvelous_Sunday; model knowledge (unverified) for the setback detail
